payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: To what extent has the image been transformed from the source into a pencil drawing?
node.criteria: Pass only when the scene as a whole convincingly reads as a pencil drawing: photographic rendering is replaced by visibly drawn, pencil-like linework and/or tonal shading across the main scene. Fail only when there is no observable drawing-like change toward that style compared with the source. Partial when there is genuine but weak or incomplete drawing-like treatment, such as visible sketch-like texture, linework, or tonal rendering, but substantial photographic structure or texture remains. Muted color, desaturation, grain, reduced detail, or softened contours alone do not establish drawing-like progress or a convincing pencil drawing; judge whether the combined evidence visibly renders the scene as drawn rather than merely washed out, blurred, or recolored. Unknown only when visual evidence is insufficient to judge.
node.binding: Compare the same regions in the source and edited images, including the food, glassware, and table setting. Inspect whether photographic forms have been replaced by visibly pencil-drawn linework or tonal shading, rather than relying on muted color, reduced detail, grain, or soft contours alone. Pass requires convincing drawn rendering across the scene as a whole. Partial requires observable drawing-like treatment but allows substantial photographic structure or texture to remain. Fail means no observable drawing-like change toward the requested style. Reserve unknown for genuinely insufficient visual evidence; do not infer a pass from a broadly positive description without supporting drawn visual features.

node_traces.evidence: Compared with the source, the edited scene has a pervasive pencil-like rendering: food, glassware, and table setting show visible fine grain, sketchy contours, and tonal shading instead of the source’s photographic color and texture. The drawn treatment is consistent across the main scene, so it reads convincingly as a pencil drawing rather than merely desaturated or softened.
